limitations: Native et/Dy with the baked catalogue: service-owned model overrides, served model knowledge and application-inference-profile metadata are absent.
Built-in name-only allowlist only; plugin skill and browser predicates are excluded; FWe uses its public default false.
Availability service state, fast-mode remote latches and live classifier execution are outside these pure-function probes.
backgroundBypassNotice: Permission mode downgraded to default: bypass in a background worker needs consent recorded in your user settings — add "skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt": true to ~/.claude/settings.json (accepting the interactive disclaimer writes the same key, but that dialog is skipped while consent already exists in .claude/settings.local.json or via --settings, which does not count here). A launch with user settings off does not read that file: relaunch with them on
